tagline: Leading nationwide operator of retail tire and automotive repair stores
hero_kpi_rationale: Key metric to assess performance of existing stores; comparable store sales reflect operational health against a 5.3% decline adjusted for selling days.

kpis.explanation: Total revenue including automotive repair services, tire replacement and related services

kpis.explanation: Sales from stores open for at least one complete fiscal year
kpis.description: Sales from stores open for at least one complete fiscal year; key metric for assessing operational performance

risks.title: Cyberattacks and Data Security
risks.score_rationale: Risk is explicitly highlighted in the 10-K with strong emphasis on the role of the CISO and Audit Committee. Language underscores growing importance of cybersecurity, notably with quarterly presentations to the Audit Committee. The 'Cybersecurity' category is highly weighted due to exposure to growing digital threats. (default score, subject to refinement)

risks.title: Economic Conditions Risks
risks.score_rationale: Document mentions high inflation, rising labor costs and possibility of recession. Language is concerning ('adverse impact', 'possibly significantly'), and this risk is central to financial analysis. It directly affects demand and margins. (default score, subject to refinement)

risks.title: Closure of 145 Underperforming Stores
risks.score_rationale: Plan to close 145 stores approved by board of directors on May 23, 2025 represents major change. Language indicates significant impact on operational structure. This risk is new and strategic, with ongoing closure costs and restructuring. (default score, subject to refinement)

risks.title: Dependence on Credit Decisions and Covenants
risks.score_rationale: Credit facility limits share buybacks and dividends. Renewal or covenant violations could restrict financial flexibility. Language mentions recent amendments ('Fifth Amendment') for increased flexibility, indicating financial pressure. (default score, subject to refinement)

risks.title: Management Change and Leadership Instability
risks.score_rationale: CEO Michael T. Broderick departure on March 27, 2025 and appointment of Peter D. Fitzsimmons on March 28, 2025, accompanied by engagement of external consultant (AlixPartners), indicates performance crisis. Language suggests urgency. This risk is new and strategic. (default score, subject to refinement)

risks.title: Potential Legal Disputes
risks.score_rationale: Document mentions ongoing litigation in normal course of business. While company asserts no material effect, it acknowledges risk exists. Tone is cautious but not alarmist. (default score, subject to refinement)

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence in the 10-K text
